name: Media Pig AF
blurb: An independent Nashville music company that develops original music with artists, produces recordings, and works on sync licensing and industry partnerships, so good music gets more chances to be heard.

name: Tone Central Station
blurb: An East Nashville music shop with guitars, cool gear and music lessons.

name: K. Butler Guitars
blurb: Custom guitars and basses built in Tennessee by a luthier with more than thirty years in the trade. Models include The '64 V2, The Shark Guitar, The Cheetah and The Wrangler.

name: Grimey's New & Preloved Music
blurb: East Nashville's record store for new and preloved vinyl, CDs, cassettes and merch, with a web store, a Discogs shop and live events.

name: The Basement Nashville
blurb: Two Nashville live music rooms: The Basement on 8th Ave S and The Basement East on Woodland Street in East Nashville.

name: Joelton Hardware, Feed & Farmacy
blurb: An independently owned hardware store in Joelton, Tennessee, open since 1964. It also has a kitchen and bar, live music, and the Joelton Country Club food co-op.

name: Duke's Nashville
blurb: A straight-up little bar in Nashville's Five Points with NYC-style deli sandwiches, cheap drinks and vinyl DJs most nights.
